about.heading: About Me
about.name: Nayituriki Adolphe
paragraphs: Student of Business Information Technology at the University of Rwanda (BIT Level 3), passionate about building digital solutions that solve real-world problems.

Full Stack Developer, System Designer, and ICT Trainer. Skilled in web development, Ai powered system, Microsoft Office, Google tools, graphic design, and teamwork. My mission: use technology to solve real challenges through efficient platforms, ICT empowerment, and community-driven projects. I help businesses, students, and organizations across Rwanda and East Africa grow through technology.
